records.source_excerpt:
40: The headquarters of registered political parties in Nigeria must be located in
A. the federal capital B. the state where most of their supporters come from C. any state capital
D. the Northern and Southern parts of Nigeria E. none of the above

candidate.subject: government
candidate.question: The headquarters of registered political parties in Nigeria must be located in

options.B: the state where most of their supporters come from
options.D: the Northern and Southern parts of Nigeria

candidate.explanation: The constitutional rule locates a registered political party's headquarters in the federal capital. A party's strongest regional support base does not determine the required national headquarters location.
